payload.rationale: The packet grounds Part I WET monitoring rows for Ceriodaphnia dubia and Pimephales promelas at measurement frequency 'Once/5 years (*2)', footnote (2) ('Perform WET testing at first discharge'), and footnote (3) directing to Part II for additional WET conditions. These passages show that footnote (2) annotates the five-year frequency, but they do not include Part II text, permit effective date, prior WET cycle timing, or any record of whether or when Outfall 001 discharged during Federal FY2025. Without discharge-occurrence evidence relative to permit timing and any prior WET cycle, the burden to establish whether WET monitoring was required in FY2025—or how to classify absent WET results when no qualifying discharge occurred—is not met. Name-linked permit language alone cannot close applicability; uncertainty is preferred over unsupported semantic closure.
